lines.japanese: 「では、今日はここまでにします。明日は２８４ページから始めるので、予習をしておくように」
lines.english: “That will be all for today. Tomorrow we'll begin on page 284, so make sure you prepare.”
“Bow.”

lines.japanese: 昼休み、僕は昼食をとる前にやることがあった。
lines.english: At lunch, I had something to do before I ate.

lines.japanese: 卒業文集製作の最後の仕事、寄せ書き集め。最初は渡来さんがやってくれてたけど、彼女が体調を崩してからはもっぱら僕の仕事になった。交渉役ってのは苦手だけど仕方ない。
lines.english: The last job on the graduation anthology was collecting everyone's messages. Watarai did it at first, but since she'd gotten sick, it was mostly my job. I was bad at being the one who had to negotiate, but there was no getting around it.

lines.japanese: 数人を残して、ほとんどのひとには書いてもらった。あと少し、これが終われば卒業文集が完成する。
lines.english: Almost everyone had written something; only a few were left. Just a little more. Once this was done, the graduation anthology was finished.

lines.japanese: 「んー……と、これでよしっと。うはー、いざ書こうとするときっちーなー」
lines.english: “Hmm... There. That'll do. Man, this is rough when you actually have to put something down.”

lines.japanese: 「ぶははっ、青春とか言っちゃってんじゃん、なに寄せ書きにマジレスしてんだよ」
lines.english: Bwahaha! Listen to you talking about youth! Why're you taking a yearbook message so damn seriously?

lines.japanese: 「だってオメ、これ一生残んだぞ！　な、委員長、ちょっと恥ずかしいくらいでちょうどいいと思わない？」
lines.english: “Hey, this thing’s gonna be around our whole lives! Right, President? It’s supposed to be a little embarrassing, don’t you think?”

lines.japanese: 「あはは」
lines.english: “Ahaha.”

lines.japanese: 「つーか、完成前でも、なんかこーゆーの見ると涙出てくるよなー。もう卒業かー」
lines.english: “Seriously, it isn't even finished and this stuff's already making me tear up. We're really graduating, huh?”

lines.japanese: みんなが書いてくれた寄せ書きは、ほとんどクラスメイトと話したことのなかった僕にとって、意外な発見ばかりだ。
lines.english: The messages everyone wrote were full of surprises for me, since I'd barely ever talked to my classmates.

lines.japanese: 彼らは恥ずかしそうにしながらも、永遠の友情やクラスの不滅を誓ってくれた。
lines.english: They were embarrassed, but they still swore eternal friendship and that our class would live forever.

lines.japanese: みんなやり直しの効かない書き込みに手を震わせながら、それが終われば僕をおつかれと労ってくれた。中には僕の名前を間違えてるひともいたけど、別に不愉快じゃない。
lines.english: Everyone's hands shook as they wrote messages with no do-overs, and when they finished, they thanked me for my work. Some even got my name wrong, but I didn't mind.

lines.japanese: 「終わったか」
lines.english: “Finished?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、はい。あとはおれたちと三人だけです」
lines.english: “Ah, yes. Now it's only us and three other people.”

lines.japanese: おれたち……と言ってから、渡来さんの席に目をやった。彼女はいつも通り明るい笑い声を立てて、僕の話したことのないクラスメイトとお弁当箱を広げている。
lines.english: Us... The word made me glance toward Watarai's seat. Just as always, she was laughing brightly over an open lunch box with classmates I had never spoken to.

lines.japanese: 「じゃあさっさとやるか。終わったら、おまえが職員室に届けてこい」
lines.english: “Then let's get it over with. When we're done, you take it to the faculty room.”

lines.japanese: 「うん、羽田君が届けるのが一番いいと思う」
lines.english: “Mm-hm. I think Haneda should be the one to deliver it.”

lines.japanese: 僕の作業の終わりを待って、教卓に針生さんと山科さんが集まってくれていた。
lines.english: Hariu and Yamashina had gathered at the teacher's desk, waiting for me to finish my part.

lines.japanese: 「えっ、どうして？」
lines.english: “What? Why me?”

lines.japanese: 「一番頑張ったから」
lines.english: “Because you worked the hardest.”

lines.japanese: 山科さんが「はい」とペンを差しだしてくれた。しゅっと指先まで血が通るのを感じて、顔が火照るのが分かったから、僕はそのペンをすぐに受けとれなかった。
lines.english: Yamashina offered me the pen with a quiet “Here.” I felt a rush of blood all the way to my fingertips. My face grew hot, and I couldn’t take the pen from her right away.

lines.japanese: 「そんな、一番頑張ったなんてことないよ。だっておれは、ただみんなにお願いをしただけで……」
lines.english: “No, I didn’t work the hardest. All I did was ask everyone for help...”

lines.japanese: 「自分じゃなにもしてないし、みんなが手伝ってくれたから、だからおれ……」
lines.english: “I haven't done anything myself. Everyone else helped, and that's why I...”

lines.japanese: あれ？
lines.english: Huh?

lines.japanese: なんだろう、クラスのみんなが僕のことを見てる。手にしたパンやお箸の手を止めて、みんなが寄せ書きを持つ僕に注目していた。
lines.english: What was going on? Everyone in class was looking at me. They'd stopped with bread or chopsticks still in hand, all watching me hold the message sheet.

lines.japanese: 僕はなんて言っていいか分からず、山科さんの差しだしてくれたペンに手を伸ばした。
lines.english: I had no idea what I was supposed to say. I reached for the pen Yamashina was holding out.

lines.japanese: 「あー、チョー腹減った！　購買マジ混みありえなくね？」
lines.english: “God, I'm starving! The school store was, like, impossibly packed!”

lines.japanese: でもそれを受けとる前に、教室のドアを叩きつけるように開いて高内さんたちが帰ってきた。どうやら、三人で昼食を買いに行ってたみたいだ。
lines.english: Before I could take it, though, Takauchi and her friends came back, throwing the classroom door open hard enough to slam it. Apparently, the three of them had gone to buy lunch together.

lines.japanese: 「チャコ、野菜サンド買ってんの。きゃはは、キュウリとか嫌いじゃなかったっけ」
lines.english: “Chako, you got a veggie sandwich? Ahaha! Didn't you hate cucumbers or something?”

lines.japanese: 「飲みもんもろくに残ってねーしな。豆乳パックとかって、マジどんだけ」
lines.english: “They barely had shit left to drink, either. A carton of soy milk? Like, seriously?”

lines.japanese: 「せーなあー、だってだよ？　うちのおかん、寝坊したくせにパン代すら出さねーの。俄然ムカつくわ」
lines.english: “Shut u-up. You know what? My mom sleeps in, then doesn't even leave me money for bread. Now I'm seriously pissed.”

lines.japanese: 「それとあの購買のババア、品揃え悪いしうぜーんだっつーの。あいつさ、とっととクビにして……ん？」
lines.english: “And that hag at the school store has a shit selection and she's annoying as hell. They oughta fire her ass already... Hm?”

lines.japanese: 僕に集まっていた注目は、そのまま高内さんたちに移動した。自席に向かおうとしていた彼女たちは、状況が飲みこめずに昼食を手にしたまま歩みを止めている。
lines.english: Everyone who'd been looking at me turned to Takauchi and her friends instead. They were heading for their seats, lunches in hand, and stopped because they had no idea what was going on.

lines.japanese: 「あ、そうだ……高内さんたちにも書いてもらわないと」
lines.english: “Oh, right... Takauchi and the others still need to write theirs.”

lines.japanese: まだ彼女たちには寄せ書きをお願いしてなかったんだ。
lines.english: I had not asked them for their messages yet.

lines.japanese: 僕はペンと原稿を持って彼女たちの元に向かった。
lines.english: I took the pen and the page over to them.

lines.japanese: 「え、なに？　なんだ、なんか用？　つか、なんなのこの空気」
lines.english: “Uh, what? What is it, you need something? And, like, what's with the vibe in here?”

lines.japanese: 「あのさ、卒業文集の寄せ書きなんだけど、まだ書いてないのは高内さんとおれの班だけなんだ」
lines.english: “It's about the messages for the graduation anthology. The only ones who haven't written anything yet are you three and my group.”

lines.japanese: 「だから、いまお願いしちゃってもいいかな」
lines.english: “So... would it be all right if I asked you to do it now?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、寄せ書き？　やるやる！　んだよ、うちらなんか悪いことしたのかと思って、マジびびったんだけど」
lines.english: “Oh, the messages? Yeah, sure! God, you guys seriously had me scared. I thought we'd done something wrong.”

lines.japanese: 「あはは、そんなことあるわけないよ」
lines.english: “Ahaha. Of course you haven't.”

lines.japanese: 僕は持っていたものを手渡すと、針生さんたちの元に戻ろうとした。高内さんも、きっと友情やクラスの不滅を誓ってくれるに違いない。
lines.english: I handed her the page and pen, then turned to rejoin Hariu and Yamashina. Takauchi, too, would surely pledge eternal friendship and swear that our class would never die.

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ、よろしく……」
lines.english: “All right, then. Thanks...”

lines.japanese: <8>\「ああーッ！　んだコレェ！」
lines.english: “What the he-e-ell is this?!”

lines.japanese: 視界に針生さんたちが映った瞬間、目に乾いた風がじりりと吹きつけてきた。
lines.english: The instant Hariu and the others came into view, a dry wind needled at my eyes.

lines.japanese: 彼らの元に向かおうとした足が動かない。背後から投げつけられた声に、僕の動きは封じられた。
lines.english: My feet refused to carry me back to them. The voice hurled at my back held me fast.

lines.japanese: 「どう……したの、かな……」
lines.english: “Is something... wrong...?”

lines.japanese: 「どーしたのじゃねーだろ！　ッんーだよ、ほとんど書くとこ残ってねーじゃん！　オメ、うちらだけ空いた隅っこに書けってワケェ！？　三人ばらばらになるじゃん！」
lines.english: “Don't ask me what's wrong! There's practically no room left! What, we're supposed to write in three different empty corners?! We won't even be together!”

lines.japanese: 「うっわ、なんなんコレ、どこ選んでも印刷で切れんじゃん？　ほんッと、ひとのこと、どーでもいいんだなおまえ」
lines.english: “Oh my god, what is this? Anywhere we pick is gonna get cut off in printing. You really don't give a shit about anyone but yourself, do you?”

lines.japanese: 「ち、違うよ、いつもお願いしようと思ってたんだけど、中々話しかける機会がなかったから……それに、みんなも同じように書いてくれたんだし、誰か一人だけを特別扱いなんてしてないはずだよ」
lines.english: “N-no. I kept meaning to ask you, but I never found a chance to talk to you... Besides, everyone else wrote in the same way. I'm sure I haven't treated any one person specially.”

lines.japanese: 教室内に風が吹きこんでくる。いつの間にか僕の踝まで砂に埋もれていた。
lines.english: Wind poured into the classroom. Before I knew it, sand had swallowed my ankles.

lines.japanese: 「こ、こふっ、こふっ……」
lines.english: “C-cough... cough...”

lines.japanese: 久しぶりに咳きこんだ。口からオークの手を突っこまれて、喉にざらついたような痛みが広がる異物感。
lines.english: I started coughing for the first time in ages. It was like an orc had shoved a hand into my mouth; a scratchy pain spread through my throat, like something foreign was lodged there.

lines.japanese: 足もとの砂塵が巻きあげられて、鼻から口から穴という穴に入りこんできた。
lines.english: The dust around my feet spiraled up and forced itself into my nose, my mouth—every hole it could find.

lines.japanese: 「だから先に順番決めとけって、いっつも言ってンだろ！　なんなんだおまえ、うちらばっかこうやって……あッ」
lines.english: “This is why I'm always telling you to decide the order first! What the hell is wrong with you? It's always us you treat like—oh.”

lines.japanese: 「オメ、わざとうちらのこと最後にしたんじゃねーだろーな」
lines.english: “You didn't leave us till last on purpose, did you?”

lines.japanese: 「なっ！」
lines.english: “What!?”

lines.japanese: 「そんなこと……してないよ……」
lines.english: “I didn’t... do that...”

lines.japanese: ごふっ！　ごふ、ごふっ！
lines.english: Khff! Cough, cough!

lines.japanese: 針生さんや山科さんに、この声は聞こえているんだろうか。僕の不手際から二人にもこの風が向かうんじゃないか心配で、どうか僕のものだけでありますようにと願った。
lines.english: Could Hariu and Yamashina hear this? I was afraid my failure would turn the wind on them as well. Please, I prayed, let it belong to me alone.

lines.japanese: 今日の風は一段と酷い。一方向からだけじゃない、右から左から背後からも、叩きつけるように風塵が襲いかかってくる。
lines.english: Today's wind was worse than ever. It did not come from only one direction. From the right, from the left, from behind—blasts of dust battered me from all sides.

lines.japanese: 僕は立っているのも辛くて、体を丸めて吹きつける暴風に耐えた。
lines.english: It hurt just to stand there. I curled in on myself and braced against the storm blowing at me.

lines.japanese: 違うんだ、ここに悲しんでいるひとがいる。僕はこんな暴風に耐えている場合じゃない。彼女を救ってあげなくちゃいけないんだ。
lines.english: No. Someone here was suffering. I had no time to endure a storm. I had to save her.

lines.japanese: 見えない、目の前にいるひとが誰なのか分からない。声はするけど、なにをしているのかが分からない。
lines.english: I couldn't see. I didn't know who was right in front of me. I could hear a voice, but I couldn't tell what they were doing.

lines.japanese: 僕は正面にいるひとの顔を確かめようと、吹きすさぶ嵐の中心で身を起こした。
lines.english: At the center of the howling storm, I forced myself upright and tried to see the face before me.

lines.japanese: 「黙ってんじゃねーよ！　それで済むならほんといいよな。どんだけ人生楽勝なんだおまえ――」
lines.english: “Say something! Must be real nice, getting off that easy. Your whole life’s one big cakewalk—”

lines.japanese: 「おい、やめとけってー。委員長、真面目にやってたじゃん」
lines.english: “Hey, knock it off. Our class president's been working hard on this.”

lines.japanese: 「だよな。なんか高内の言ってること、自己チューにもほどがあるっつーかー、被害妄想くさくねえ？」
lines.english: “Yeah. I mean, Takauchi, this is way past self-centered. You're starting to sound seriously paranoid.”
“What!?”

lines.japanese: 「えっ」
lines.english: “Huh?”

lines.japanese: ふと、身を襲う風が弱まって、視界が急に明るくなった。
lines.english: Then, without warning, the wind weakened and my vision flooded with light.

lines.japanese: 足元に積もっていた砂塵が流されていく。もう一度よく見れば、そこにはグレー色の絨毯が敷いてあるだけだ。
lines.english: The dust heaped around my feet streamed away. When I looked again, there was nothing beneath me but gray carpet.

lines.japanese: 「なに、ワケわかんね。カンケーないんだから口出すなっつの」
lines.english: “What? That doesn't even make sense. This has nothing to do with you, so stay the hell out of it.”

lines.japanese: 「つか、そっちのがワケわかんね。クラスの文集なんだから、俺らカンケーなくねーだろ」
lines.english: “You're the one who doesn't make sense. It's our class anthology. How's that got nothing to do with us?”

lines.japanese: 「大体、高内も学級委員なんだから、なんもやってないのおかしくねえ？」
lines.english: “Besides, aren’t you a class president too, Takauchi? Isn’t it weird that you haven’t done any of the work?”

lines.japanese: 「な！　やったっつーの、マジふざけんな？　仕事分担して、あんたらも納得してたじゃん。なに今さら、私だけ責められてんのとか、ぜっておかしーし」
lines.english: “What?! I did my share, so don't fuck with me! We split up the work, and you all agreed to it. It's total bullshit to blame only me now!”

lines.japanese: 「チャコー、もーいーじゃん。三人一緒に書けばよくね？」
lines.english: “Chako, come on, who cares anymore? Can't the three of us just write together?”

lines.japanese: 「うちら残ってんとこでいーし、終わらせよーぜ」
lines.english: “Whatever space is left is fine with us. Let's get it over with.”

lines.japanese: 「え、なに？　なんなの、私だけ悪いっつの？　あんたら全員マジでムカつくし！　私いま軽くキレてんだけど」
lines.english: “What? What the hell? So now I'm the only one in the wrong? Every last one of you seriously pisses me off! I'm a little pissed off now, okay?”

lines.japanese: 風の音が聞こえない。身を起こせば、吹きとばされそうな暴風はいつの間にか止んでいた。開けた視界の中にはかわいそうなひとが立っているだけだ。
lines.english: I couldn't hear the wind anymore. When I straightened up, the storm that had almost blown me away was gone. All I could see now was one poor person standing there.

lines.japanese: そうだ、誰かが傷ついたりしてはいけないんだ。僕はそのひとの前に立って、彼女に向かう風を受けとめた。
lines.english: Yes. No one should ever be hurt. I stepped in front of her and caught the wind meant for her.

lines.japanese: 「違うよ、高内さんは悪くないんだ」
lines.english: “No. Takauchi hasn't done anything wrong.”

lines.japanese: 「ここには、誰も……悪いひとなんて居ないんだ」
lines.english: “There isn't anyone... There isn't a bad person here.”

lines.japanese: 教室の中のいくつもの目が、僕の姿を見つめていた。このやさしい目に囲まれてしまわないように、僕はかわいそうなひとの前に立って、その姿を覆いかくした。
lines.english: Eyes all over the classroom were staring at me. So those kind eyes wouldn't surround her, I stood in front of that poor person and hid her from view.

lines.japanese: 渡来さんがまっすぐな顔で僕を見てる。針生さんの視線も僕に向けられていた。山科さんは心配そうに手を胸に当てている。
lines.english: Watarai stared straight at me, her face solemn. Hariu was watching too. Yamashina held one hand anxiously to her chest.

lines.japanese: 大丈夫、この空はどこにも繋がってないんだ。ここはとてものどかな国で、心のやさしいひとしかこの国には居ないんだ。
lines.english: It was all right. This sky connected to nowhere. This was a peaceful country, and no one but the gentle-hearted lived here.

lines.japanese: だからそんな心配そうな顔をしないで。
lines.english: So please don't look at me with such worry.
“Fuck off!”

lines.japanese: 背中になにかがぶつかってきた。こらえようとしたけど、それがあまりに唐突だったから、僕は衝撃に耐えきれずにグレーの絨毯敷きの上に突っぷした。
lines.english: Something struck me from behind. I tried to brace myself, but it came too suddenly. The impact overwhelmed me, and I pitched face-first onto the gray carpet.

lines.japanese: 「さっきッから、なんなんだっつの！　つか誰も頼んでねんだよ、うーわ、マジ信じらんね。オメひとのこと悪役扱いしてなに笑ってんの？」
lines.english: “What the hell is wrong with you?! You've been at this for ages! Nobody asked you to save me. Oh my god, I seriously can't believe you. You make me the villain, then stand there smiling?”

lines.japanese: 「高内さんは悪くないよ、みんな、話せば、ちゃんと分かってくれるんだ」
lines.english: “You haven't done anything wrong, Takauchi. If we talk, everyone will understand.”

lines.japanese: 「ハ？　なんなんコイツ？　いやほんと、マジで意味がワカランでしょ？　な？　自分でさんざ掻きまわして、なにヨユーぶっこいてんの？」
lines.english: “Huh? What the hell is with this guy? Seriously, none of this makes any sense, right? You stir all this shit up yourself, then act like you're above it all?”

lines.japanese: 「昨日だって、ほら写真！　直せっつったのに、直してねーじゃん！」
lines.english: “Yesterday too! Look, the pictures! I told you to fix them and you didn't!”

lines.japanese: 「え、それは……」
lines.english: “But I...”

lines.japanese: 高内さんは僕の机にあった原稿をつかむと、その一番上に重ねてあった写真のページを僕に突きつけた。
lines.english: Takauchi snatched the manuscript from my desk and thrust its topmost sheet—the page of photographs—in my face.

lines.japanese: 「だって、あの写真が嫌だって言うから、違うものを用意したんだ。ちゃんと直したんだよ」
lines.english: “But you said you hated that picture, so I found a different one. I did fix it.”

lines.japanese: 「バッカじゃネーの！？　オメ直すってのは、も少しマシな写真選べってことだよ！　同じよーな写真持ってきたら、また直さなくちゃいけねーじゃねーか、そんくらい頭使えよ、童貞×んぽ！」
lines.english: “Are you fucking stupid?! By ‘fix it,’ I meant pick a picture where I look halfway decent! Bring me another one just like it and I’ll only have to tell you to fix it again! Use your head, virgin dick!”

lines.japanese: 「大体、今どき手作りってなんなん？　ハッ！　パソコンでやんだろフツー。だっせえモン作りやがって、いつの時代の卒文だよくっだらねえ！」
lines.english: “And who the hell makes this stuff by hand anymore? Hah! Normal people use a computer. This thing looks like shit. What century is this pathetic yearbook from?”

lines.japanese: 「センスもねーくせに勝手なことすンな、キメーんだよオメエ、いつもいつもいつも！　社会に出てくんな、即死しろバカ！」
lines.english: “You’ve got no taste, so quit doing whatever the hell you want! You make my skin crawl—you always have, always, always! Don’t ever come out into the real world. Drop dead, moron!”

lines.japanese: 「待って、話を聞いて。大丈夫、おれは分かってるから、高内さんはやさしいひとなんだ」
lines.english: “Wait. Listen to me. It's all right; I understand. You're a kind person, Takauchi.”

lines.japanese: 「っセーな！　明日香様にシャレで遊ばれてんのに、舞いあがってるし、おまえどっかおかしーんじゃないの？　友達もいねーし、会話一つできねーし、馬鹿にされてんのも気づいてねーし」
lines.english: “Shut up! Lady Asuka toys with you for laughs and you get all excited. Is there something wrong with your head? You have no friends, you can't even hold a conversation, and you don't notice when people are making fun of you.”

lines.japanese: 「いっつもへらへら笑いやがってキメーんだよ、人格ねーのかテメーは！」
lines.english: “You just stand there grinning all the time. It's fucking creepy. Do you even have a personality?”

lines.japanese: 彼女の言葉の意味は分からなかったけど、渡来さんがぎゅっと手を握っているのが目に入った。高内さんが手にしている原稿を振りあげる。
lines.english: I did not understand what she meant, but I saw Watarai clench her fist. Takauchi raised the manuscript in her hand.

lines.japanese: クラスみんなの写真が貼られた原稿が、四つん這いになった僕の目の前に叩きつけられて、その上に高内さんの足が降ってきた。ぐりぐりと足が左右に揺れる。
lines.english: Takauchi slapped the page bearing all our class photographs down in front of me where I knelt on all fours. Her foot came down on top of it and ground slowly from side to side.

lines.japanese: 高内さんの声が響いているはずなのに、やけに教室が静まりかえっているように感じた。音が、なにも聞こえない。
lines.english: Takauchi's voice must have been ringing through the room, yet the classroom seemed unnaturally still. I could hear nothing.

lines.japanese: 「おい」
lines.english: “Hey.”

lines.japanese: やっと僕の耳に入ってきたのは、鋭い、それでいて重い低音だった。
lines.english: The sound that finally reached me was low and heavy, with a cutting edge.

lines.japanese: 針生さんだ。頭が良くて知識もあって、趣味が多くて忙しいはずなのに、時間を割いて文集の製作を最後まで手伝ってくれた年上の同級生。
lines.english: Hariu. My older classmate, smart and knowledgeable. He had so many hobbies he had to be busy, but he still made time to help us with the anthology all the way to the end.

lines.japanese: 「まあ、黙って聞いてりゃア、好き勝手言ってくれて。覚悟はァ、出来てんだよな？」
lines.english: “Well, well. I've kept quiet and listened to you say any damn thing you please. You're ready for what comes next, I trust?”

lines.japanese: 「うぜーよハリウッドのおっさん。人の話に口出さないでくれる？」
lines.english: “You're annoying, Hollywood geezer. Wanna keep your nose out of other people's business?”

lines.japanese: 「同感だな。これは俺とおまえの問題だ」
lines.english: “My sentiments exactly. This is between you and me.”

lines.japanese: 「はあ？」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 「邪魔だ、どいてろ」
lines.english: “You're in my way. Move.”

lines.japanese: 針生さんが歩みよってきた。彼の前に居たクラスメイトたちが身を引くようにして道を開いていく。
lines.english: Hariu walked over. The classmates in front of him drew back and made room.

lines.japanese: 「おまえがいまァ……その、汚ったねえ足で踏んづけてるそれは、俺が作ったもんだ」
lines.english: “That thing you're stepping on right now... with that filthy foot of yours. I made it.”

lines.japanese: 「なァ、さっきおまえは言ったな。センスもない童貞×んぽだと。はン、なかなか言ってくれンじゃないの。これが俺とおまえの問題じゃなくて、なんだってんだ」
lines.english: Hey. You said it yourself just now, didn't you? No taste. Virgin dick. Hah. You've got a hell of a mouth on you. How the hell is this not between you and me?

lines.japanese: 「な、なんだよ……こっち来んなよハリウッド……」
lines.english: “Wh-what the hell... Don't come any closer, Hollywood...”

lines.japanese: 高内さんの制止の声を聞かず、針生さんは彼女に手の届く範囲まで近づいた。そこでぐりんと首を回して、睨みだけで相手の動きを封じこめる。
lines.english: Ignoring Takauchi’s warning, Hariu came within arm’s reach. Then he turned his head sharply and stopped her cold with a look.

lines.japanese: 「なァおまえ、旦那と子供どっちが大事だ？」
lines.english: “Tell me something. Which matters more to you: your husband or your child?”

lines.japanese: 「は？　な、なにいきなり、ワケわかんない」
lines.english: “What? Wh-why would you ask me that out of nowhere? That makes no sense.”

lines.japanese: 「おまえだっていつかは結婚するでしょう。いいから答えろよ、旦那と子供だ」
lines.english: “You'll marry someday, won't you? Just answer me. Husband or child?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、あァ？　そんなの、別に子供とかキョーミねえし、旦那に決まってんじゃん」
lines.english: “H-huh? Like I give a shit about kids. My husband, obviously.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ腹だな。顔は大事なんだろ」
lines.english: “The stomach, then. You care about your face.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 瞬間、針生さんの腰に力がぐんと入って、相手の鳩尾めがけて右の蹴りが繰りだされた。
lines.english: In that instant, power drove through Hariu's hips and his right leg lashed toward her solar plexus.

lines.japanese: 「きゃあっ！」
lines.english: “Aah!”

lines.japanese: 「あぶないっ」
lines.english: “Look out!”

lines.japanese: 飛びあがった。僕は彼女を守らなくちゃいけない。
lines.english: I sprang. I had to protect her.

lines.japanese: だって今日の朝、昇降口で彼女は僕のことを心配してくれたから。彼女はとてもやさしいひとなんだ。
lines.english: After all, she'd worried about me at the school entrance that morning. She was a really kind person.

lines.japanese: いつも体育の授業じゃまるで動かない僕の体が、嘘みたいに跳ねあがった。そうだ、僕はグレタガルドでの活躍を隠すために、いつからか本気を出すのを恐れて――
lines.english: My body, which never moved at all in gym, sprang up as if all of that had been a lie. Right. At some point I'd grown afraid to go all out, because I had to hide my exploits in Gretagard—

lines.japanese: 「ごぼっ！」
lines.english: “Guh!”

lines.japanese: 僕の左脇腹に、針生さんの右足が突きささっていた。胃の中のものが込みあげてくる感触がして、口と鼻と頭の中に酸っぱい味が広がったけど、昼食前だったのが幸いして、口から出たのは胃液のみだった。
lines.english: Hariu's right foot buried itself in my left side. Something surged up from my stomach, flooding my mouth, my nose, even the inside of my skull with sourness. Luckily I had not eaten lunch, so nothing came out but stomach acid.

lines.japanese: 「へえ」
lines.english: “Well, well.”

lines.japanese: 「羽田君！」
lines.english: “Haneda!”

lines.japanese: 「違うよ……高内さんはやさしいひとなんだ……」
lines.english: “No... Takauchi is a kind person...”

lines.japanese: どろんとした闇が落ちて、意識が深い場所に沈んでいく。金色の触媒に包み込まれる感覚とは別の、黒い世界の幕が下りてきた。
lines.english: Viscous darkness fell, and my awareness sank somewhere deep. This was different from being enveloped in the golden catalyst. A curtain of black descended across the world.

lines.japanese: 「違うんだ……高内さんはおれに話しかけてくれてたんだ……いつもおれが答えられなかっただけなんだ……」
lines.english: “No... Takauchi did talk to me... I was the one who could never answer her...”

lines.japanese: 「だっておれは、なにかあるとこの世界からいなくなってたから……」
lines.english: “Because whenever anything happened, I would disappear from this world...”

lines.japanese: 意識とともに体が落ちていく。地面に触れる寸前、絨毯に座りこんだ高内さんの顔が見えた。
lines.english: My body fell as my consciousness slipped away. Just before I hit the floor, I saw Takauchi sitting on the carpet.
“What...?”
“Haneda...?”

lines.japanese: どさりと誰かが地面に倒れる音がした。おかしいな、声は聞こえるのに、世界がどうなっているかまるで分からない。
lines.english: There was a heavy thud as someone fell to the ground. That's strange. I could hear voices, but I had no idea what was happening to the world.

lines.japanese: 「ごめんね……この世界には……」
lines.english: “I'm sorry... In this world...”

lines.japanese: 「悪いひとなんて、誰も……居ないんだ……」
lines.english: “There isn't... a single bad person...”

lines.japanese: 「羽田君っ！」
lines.english: “Haneda!”

lines.japanese: 「ハハ、さすがだなァ……おまえ、ロックだよ羽田ァ！　いまの動きはナリタ、いや、陛下にも劣らなかったぜェ！」
lines.english: “Ha ha! That's our man... You're rock and roll, Haneda! That move was worthy of Narita—no, of His Majesty himself!”

lines.japanese: 「くくっ、くっくっく……げーらげらげらげら！」
lines.english: “Heh... heh heh heh... Gya-ha-ha-ha-ha!”

lines.japanese: 「先輩、笑ってる場合じゃないでしょ！？　羽田君、羽田君っ！」
lines.english: “Hariu, this is no time to laugh! Haneda! Haneda!”

lines.japanese: 「羽田君っ……私……」
lines.english: “Haneda... I...”

lines.japanese: 僕の大切なひとたちの声が聞こえる。
lines.english: I could hear the voices of the people I cared about.

lines.japanese: なんだ、世界は……そうだ、やっぱりそうだったんだ。
lines.english: Oh. The world was... Yes. It was just as I’d thought.

lines.japanese: この世界は、平和で満たされていたんだ。
lines.english: This world was filled with peace.

lines.japanese: ブブッ
lines.english: Bzzzt.

lines.japanese: ブブッブブッブブッ
lines.english: Bzzzt. Bzzzt. Bzzzt.

lines.japanese: な、んだろう……体の中でなにか震えてる気がする……。
lines.english: Wh-what was that...? Something inside my body seemed to be trembling...

lines.japanese: 僕はずしりと重い頭を起こしながら、五感を目覚めさせようと意識を集中した。
lines.english: I lifted my heavy head and focused on waking up all five senses.

lines.japanese: ブブッ
lines.english: Bzzzt.

lines.japanese: これは、体の中……じゃない、ポケットの中だ。てことは……ケータイ？
lines.english: It wasn't inside my body... It was inside my pocket. Which meant... my phone?

lines.japanese: 目の前がはっきりしないままポケットからケータイを取りだして、意識せずに通話ボタンを押した。
lines.english: My sight still blurred, I pulled the phone from my pocket and pressed the answer button without thinking.

lines.japanese: 「はい……もしもし」
lines.english: “Hello...?”

lines.japanese: 「もしもし？」
lines.english: “Hello?”

lines.japanese: 「あれ？　この声は……」
lines.english: “Wait. That voice...”

lines.japanese: 「あ、羽田君？　私のこと分かる？」
lines.english: “Haneda? Do you know who this is?”

lines.japanese: 「渡来、渡来明日香」
lines.english: “Watarai. Asuka Watarai.”

lines.japanese: 「わた、ら、い……」
lines.english: “Wata... rai...”

lines.japanese: 「えっ」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 「わたらいさん！？」
lines.english: “Watarai?!”

lines.japanese: 急に布団の重みと温もりが伝わってきた。薬品の香り。ここは病院なのかな。
lines.english: All at once, I felt the weight and warmth of a blanket. The smell of medicine. Was I in a hospital?

lines.japanese: だとしたら、医療機関でのケータイの使用は厳禁だ。
lines.english: If so, using a cell phone inside a medical facility was strictly forbidden.

lines.japanese: 僕は体にかかっていた布団をふっ飛ばすと、ベッドから転がりおちつつ、急いでドアの外へと走りでた。
lines.english: I flung the blanket off, tumbled out of bed, and dashed through the door.

lines.japanese: 「渡来さん、どうしたの！？」
lines.english: “Watarai! What happened?!”

lines.japanese: 僕は息を切らしながら、ケータイに向かって声を出した。
lines.english: Still panting, I spoke into the phone.

lines.japanese: 「ちょ、ちょっ……羽田君、声が大きい」
lines.english: “W-wait... Haneda, you're shouting.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ？　あ、そうかも……あの、どうしたの」
lines.english: “Huh? Oh. Maybe I am... Um, what happened?”

lines.japanese: 「どうしたのって、覚えてないの？」
lines.english: “What happened? You don't remember?”

lines.japanese: 「覚えてって……あれ、そういえばここって、学校……？」
lines.english: “Remember...? Wait, is this... school?”

lines.japanese: 周囲を見ると、どうやら校内みたいだ。目の前の教室には保健室の札がかかっているから、僕はここから出てきたんだと思う。
lines.english: I looked around. Seemed like I was still at school. The room in front of me had a NURSE'S OFFICE sign, so I guess that's where I'd come from.

lines.japanese: 「先輩に蹴られて保健室に運ばれたの、覚えてない？」
lines.english: “You don't remember Hariu kicking you and us carrying you to the nurse's office?”

lines.japanese: 「針生さんに……」
lines.english: “Hariu kicked me...”

lines.japanese: まだ重い頭を押さえると、ずきりとした痛みが脇腹に走った。触ってみるとかなり痛む。おそらく痣になってるだろう。
lines.english: I held my still-heavy head, and pain stabbed through my side. It hurt badly when I touched it. There was probably quite a bruise there.

lines.japanese: 「針生さんに蹴られたところまでは覚えてるんだけど、そのあとどうなったか、思いだせないんだ」
lines.english: “I remember everything up to Hariu kicking me, but I can't remember what happened afterward.”

lines.japanese: 「そうなんだ」
lines.english: “I see.”

lines.japanese: 「みんなで羽田君を保健室に運んで、あとは先生が来ちゃったから解散。羽田班は先生に呼びだされて、全員事情聴取……あと、高内たちも」
lines.english: “We all carried you to the nurse’s office. Then a teacher showed up, so we scattered. Everyone in the Haneda Squad got called in for questioning... Takauchi and her friends too.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、そうだ！　高内さんは？　平気だった？」
lines.english: “Oh, right! Takauchi—was she okay?”

lines.japanese: 「ははっ……」
「え、なんで。どうして笑うのさ」
lines.english: “What? Why? Why are you laughing?”

lines.japanese: 「ううん、羽田君はほんと偉いよね。うん、高内は怪我もしてないし、寄せ書きだけ済ませて大人しく帰ったよ」
lines.english: “Nothing. You're really something, Haneda. Takauchi wasn't hurt. She wrote her message and went quietly home.”

lines.japanese: 「先輩と山科は写真のとこだけやり直すために今も作業してる……さっき見たら、あと少しだったよね」
lines.english: “Hariu and Yamashina are still working because they have to redo the photo part... When I looked a minute ago, they were almost finished.”

lines.japanese: 「ふーん……あれ？　渡来さんはなにしてるの。手伝ってよ」
lines.english: “Oh... Wait. What are you doing, Watarai? Go help them.”

lines.japanese: 「うん無理」
lines.english: “Yeah, can’t.”

lines.japanese: 「さぼるなよぅ」
lines.english: “Don't sl-a-ack off.”

lines.japanese: 渡来さんは悪びれもせずに言ってのけた。彼女らしいと言えば彼女らしいけど、手伝いくらいはしてあげて欲しい。
lines.english: Watarai said it without looking sorry at all. That was just like her, but I wished she'd at least help them a little.

lines.japanese: 「手伝ってあげたいんだけど、私は他に用事があるんだよね」
lines.english: “I'd love to help them, but I've got something else to do.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、じゃあ仕方ないね」
lines.english: Oh. Then I guess there's nothing we can do.

lines.japanese: 僕はおなかを押さえつつ、保健室の位置を思いだす。教室まではどうやって行くんだったっけ。
lines.english: I held my stomach and tried to remember where the nurse's office was. Which way was it to the classroom again?

lines.japanese: 「それじゃあ、ぼ……おれは手伝いに行ってくるよ。ありがとう、渡来さん」
lines.english: “Well, I... I'll go and help them. Thank you, Watarai.”

lines.japanese: 「ちょおっと、待ったあ」
lines.english: “Wai-it just a minute.”
“Hm?”

lines.japanese: 歩きかけたとき、携帯電話から飛びだすような声が聞こえてきた。
lines.english: I had just started walking when a voice leapt out of the phone after me.

lines.japanese: 「なに？」
lines.english: “What is it?”

lines.japanese: 「作業してる二人にはほんと心苦しいんだけどさ、羽田君と話したいことがあるんだよね」
lines.english: “I really do feel bad for those two working away, but there's something I want to talk to you about, Haneda.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 渡来さんから僕に話？　そうだ、渡来さんに話したいことは僕もあるんだ。
lines.english: Watarai wanted to talk to me? Right, I had something I wanted to tell her too.

lines.japanese: 「な、なになに、おれに聞きたいことってなに？　良かったら話を聞くけど、それでいいかな」
lines.english: “W-what is it? What did you want to ask me? I mean, I can listen if you want. Is that okay?”

lines.japanese: 「んー、まずは落ち着いて？」
lines.english: “Hmm. First, could you calm down?”
“Leave it to me!”

lines.japanese: 「羽田君、人差し指をチョキにしてみて」
lines.english: Haneda, make a V with your fingers.

lines.japanese: 「ん？　こうかな？」
lines.english: “Hm? Like this?”

lines.japanese: 「それを目の前に構えてみて」
lines.english: “Now hold them up in front of your eyes.”

lines.japanese: 「うんうん、構えたよ」
lines.english: Mm-hm, all set.

lines.japanese: 「そのまま顔を前に倒してみるといいよ」
lines.english: Now just lean your face forward like that.

lines.japanese: 「痛っ！」
lines.english: “Ow!”

lines.japanese: 渡来さんの指示通りに動いたのに、何故か指が目に突きささった。こういう悪ふざけはやめて欲しい。
lines.english: I had moved exactly as Watarai instructed, yet somehow my fingers stabbed me in the eyes. I wished she would stop playing tricks like this.

lines.japanese: 「うんじゃあ、落ちついたかな。今からうちに来られない？」
lines.english: “All right, are you calm now? Can you come over to my place?”

lines.japanese: 「え、いいの？」
lines.english: “What? I can?”

lines.japanese: 「ん……先輩に蹴られた体も心配だし、落ちついて話せる場所の方がいいもんね」
lines.english: “Mm... I'm worried about you after that kick from Hariu, and we'd be better off somewhere we can talk in peace.”

lines.japanese: 「うん、行くよ！　すぐに行くから待ってて」
lines.english: “Yes, I'll come! I'll be right there, so wait for me!”

lines.japanese: 「あ、そんなに大声出すと体が……」
lines.english: “Wait, if you shout that loud, your body—”

lines.japanese: 「あだっ」
lines.english: “Ow!”

lines.japanese: 「だ、大丈夫！？」
lines.english: “A-are you all right!?”

lines.japanese: 「ははっ、全然痛くないよ」
lines.english: “Ha ha! It doesn't hurt at all.”

lines.japanese: よかった、渡来さんには避けられてなかったみたいだ。これでようやく土曜日の話が出来る。
lines.english: Thank goodness. It seemed Watarai had not been avoiding me after all. At last, we could talk about Saturday.

lines.japanese: 針生さんと山科さんには申し訳ないけど、今日は体も痛いし甘えさせてもらおう。僕は通話を終わらせると、痛む脇腹を押さえながら昇降口に向かった。
lines.english: I felt bad for Hariu and Yamashina, but my whole body hurt, so I'd let myself rely on them today. I hung up and headed for the school entrance, clutching my sore side.
